notes: Variant is the standard forearm plank from elbows and toes. Rectus abdominis and external oblique are primary because direct plank EMG repeatedly measured them and modified-plank evidence shows clear abdominal response to increased anti-extension demand. Internal oblique is secondary from direct standard plank EMG. Erector spinae is support only because direct sources measured spinal-extensor activity but the stable plank is not primarily a back-extension exercise. Transversus abdominis and quadratus lumborum were intentionally not listed as visible roles because data/anatomy.json does not expose those muscles as local display targets.
